tool_schemas.name: create_workflow
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new n8n workflow snapshot from the provided nodes and optional connections, validating required fields and returning the persisted workflow definition including its nodes, connections, and initial lifecycle state (for example, draft). Connections are validated to ensure each source and target refers to an existing node name and that node names are unique within the workflow; workflows with invalid node types/names or broken connection references raise VALIDATION_ERROR. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the caller cannot create workflows, QUOTA_EXCEEDED if creation limits are reached, and CONFLICT if a workflow with the same identifier in the same scope already exists.

metadata.name: n8n Workflow Builder
metadata.description: This backend stores programmatically generated n8n workflow definitions, including their nodes and node-to-node connections. The primary workflow is accepting a create_workflow request, validating node names/types and connection integrity, persisting a workflow snapshot, and tracking lifecycle state
